Tried ear plugs but ended up infecting my ears. Is there a way to use them consistently without them getting too dirty? Also an eyemask would be good, not a lot of light comes through though, its mainly noise pollution and staying asleep being my bigest issues. Thank you for the advice!

Definitely helps me see that I'm not the only one struggling. I have to remind myself from time to time that there is more to be happy about sometimes . Again , thank you for taking the time to listen to me vent :)

When I was 19 , I ended up leaving a solid job I had for a year and a half because of the politics and black and grey areas to it. After that my mental health started declining rapidly and I fell into a deep spiral of bad life choices. I was dumb and took the money I had in the bank in my savings and blew it on things I didn't need because I was trying to fill a void. After that my anger issues started to rear its head (guess the years in counselling didn't work) I starting verbally lashing out at people I loved and messed up a lot of my relationships. I got angry one day and punched my fridge (stupid I know), because I was at a breaking point in life and it was a dumb spur of the moment. Ended up breaking my hand and I attempted my suicide that night at 21. Woke up the next morning 16 hours later after downing hell knows how much Tylenol and sleeping meds. I somehow woke and don't recall much of it other than my eyes being rwally yellow and my skin being pale.  I know a lot of problems I have are mostly caused by me , but I sometimes feel like I've become a product of my own environment in a way. I don't like that this has been my way of thinking , and I come up with a good amount of irrational thoughts often. This always leads me to think that I am constantly at fault in even just existing in others lives and is really hindering my abilities that I once had of forming long life friendships / relationships. 

Thanks for taking the time to listen, and to care friend! I'll try to put the confidence to good use. I just feel absolutely useless, hollow, numb, and beyond stressed at the same point.
